ValidationRule.description: Target reason must be populated when Target Revenue is below Projected EOY sales
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Ready for Review"), NOT(ISBLANK(Target_Revenue__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Projected_EOY_Sales__c)), Target_Revenue__c < Projected_EOY_Sales__c, ISBLANK(Target_Reason__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide a Target Reason because Target Revenue is below Project EOY Sales.
